### Problem Description
Is your feature request related to a problem? A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Specification & Invariant Impact
How does this interact with `INVARIANT.md`? Does it require new specification syntax, an adapter, or a verification check?

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
